summary: OpenGL and GL context code was hardened for better synchronization and reliability, especially on macOS with Metal ANGLE. WebRender and WebGL now coordinate using egl/Metal sync primitives (MTLSharedEvent / eglWaitUntilWorkScheduledANGLE) so canvas snapshots, exports, and compositing are less likely to race or miss frames. Other fixes prevent accidental deletion of borrowed framebuffer backings and expose higher-power EGL context flags, improving stability and performance for accelerated canvases.
